tests.scope: tiny synthetic arrays, scalar records and temporary files only; no actual official arrays read

checks: Default has no data action; execution requires explicit completed structural report/hash and fresh output.
Complete exact train/valid structural schema/converter/metadata/source pins and published manifest/count identity checked; no hardcoded record counts or particle types.
Optional step_context presence recorded for every source record, with explicit absent rows. Present arrays require safe exact paths, SHA/size/dtype/shape and source-frame alignment.
Census records finite/NaN/infinity counts, unique float32 bits and multiplicities; no values normalized/replaced and no semantic inference from numerical patterns.
Published input and source hashes rechecked at completion; failed and partial census retained. Report itself does not admit scientific training.
Official-parser omission rests on separate source-supported semantics review bound by metadata/context source hashes.
limits: Source review and synthetic tests do not certify actual full-source census; root must run and verify it.
NaNs, constants or absent auxiliaries alone do not establish omission semantics.
